title: There’s No Way To Block Podcasts
review:
There is no way to block individual podcasts, and using the “Not Interested” button simply doesn’t work. The same 3-4 podcasts are recommended ad nauseum despite not being followed or listened too, and there is no way to remove or hide them. Topic you hate? Too bad! Here’s 10 more podcasts about it we think you’ll love, and no way to toggle away from them. This happens daily, I must’ve clicked “Not Interested” on hundreds of episodes from the same podcast at this point.

After over 10 years of premium membership and reaching out several times to support, I went ahead and cancelled my plan. Why would I want to come back to a platform that keeps recommending me things that I hate?

title: Read the review if you want honesty

I don’t mind ads at all, but when I’m trying to edit a playlist and I’m forced into a visual ad for several minutes before I can continue it makes me not want to use the app at all. I know it’s a marketing thing more than likely to make people want to get premium but that’s not an option for everyone. I also never realized DJX was a premium only feature and I miss him.. You could even have him transition into ads to be interactive and still give people access. There’s many ideas like that I have but I won’t waste any more time on that here. title: Struggles in offline mode
review: I’ve been using Spotify premium for several years now, but my hang up with the app has remained the same: download only mode. When I turn off my data or find myself in a place without signal the player fails in a variety of ways. My main problems are that if I pause it for more than a couple of minutes then press play again, it will play a couple of seconds before it stops playing indefinitely or until I reset the app. What’s worse, there have been a few times when it will display my downloaded stuff but will not play anything at all no matter what until I turn on my data and reset the app (which defeats the purpose of download mode). They may not seem like huge concerns, but they have definitely become quite annoying after so many years.

title: UI Issues
review: The user interface updates have been bothering me for a long time. I used to listen to a wide variety of podcasts, some seasonally because it’s a lot of sports podcasts. The recommended feed is so off-base with what my actual tastes are. The lack of personalization is beyond frustrating for a product I use so frequently. I appreciate the libraries available and love listening to so much content but it’s gotten to the point where I am considering Apple Music. It’s a shame, I’ve been a loyal customer for 9 years.
